messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The loan approval process starts by receiving a customer request for a loan amount. The risk assessment Web service is invoked to assess the request. If the loan is small and the customer is low risk, the loan is approved. If the customer is high risk, the loan is denied. If the customer needs further review or the loan amount is for $10,000 or more, the request is sent to the approver Web service. The customer receives feedback from the assessor or approver.

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LoanApproval"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">
  
  <bpmn:process id="LoanApprovalProcess" name="Loan Approval Process" isExecutable="true">
    
    <!-- Start Event -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_LoanRequested" name="Loan Request Received">
      <bpmn:outgoing">SequenceFlow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Start" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <!-- Service Task: Risk Assessment WS -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_AssessRisk" name="Assess Risk (Risk Assessment WS)" implementation="##WebService">
      <bpmn:incoming">SequenceFlow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing">SequenceFlow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Risk & Amount Evaluation -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RiskEvaluation" name="Evaluate Risk and Amount">
      <bpmn:incoming">SequenceFlow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing">SequenceFlow_LowRiskSmallAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing">SequenceFlow_HighRisk</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing">SequenceFlow_NeedsFurtherReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Service Task: Approver WS -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_ApproverService" name="Approve Loan (Approver WS)" implementation="##WebService">
      <bpmn:incoming">SequenceFlow_NeedsFurtherReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing">SequenceFlow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Merge Assessment / Approval Results -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeResults">
      <bpmn:incoming">SequenceFlow_LowRiskSmallAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming">SequenceFlow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing">SequenceFlow_ToFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Send Task: Send Feedback to Customer -->
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendFeedback" name="Send Feedback to Customer" implementation="##WebService">
      <bpmn:incoming">SequenceFlow_ToFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming">SequenceFlow_HighRisk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing">SequenceFlow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <!-- End Event -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LoanProcessed" name="Loan Processed">
      <bpmn:incoming">SequenceFlow_04</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_LoanRequested" targetRef="ServiceTask_AssessRisk" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_02" sourceRef="ServiceTask_AssessRisk" targetRef="Gateway_RiskEvaluation" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_LowRiskSmallAmount" name="Low Risk & Amount &#lt; $10,000 (Approved)" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskEvaluation" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResults">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${riskLevel == 'LOW' && amount < 10000}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_HighRisk" name="High Risk (Denied)" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskEvaluation" targetRef="SendTask_SendFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${riskLevel == 'HIGH'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_NeedsFurtherReview" name="Further Review or Amount &#gt;= $10,000" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskEvaluation" targetRef="ServiceTask_ApproverService">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${riskLevel == 'MEDIUM' || amount >= 10000}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_03" sourceRef="ServiceTask_ApproverService" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResults" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeResults" targetRef="SendTask_SendFeedback" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_04" sourceRef="SendTask_SendFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_LoanProcessed" />

  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- BPMN Diagram Graphical Information -->
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_1" bpmnElement="LoanApprovalProcess">
      
      <!-- Start Event -->

        <dc:Bounds x="152" y="212" width="36" height="36" />

        <dc:Bounds x="395" y="205" width="50" height="50" />
```
